label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: [s01]
Cc: none
Subject: none

Renee, here's my rundown for the noon meeting. Man, what a week.

Game: We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday night, and that locks up 2nd in the region. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 touchdowns, including a long one in the 3rd quarter. Our line pushed them 5 yards back that whole drive, best I've seen them block all year. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles, and the defense held them to 46 rushing yards in the second half. The kids voted Deshawn defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met.

Playoffs: We got a HOME game. We host Clanton Valley in the first round this Friday, Nov 13, 7pm at Ridge Field. Ticket presale starts tomorrow. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows it's at our place. I'd love to see the word get out and folks come out for these kids.

Grades: The 9 weeks grade check came back and all 52 kids on the roster are eligible. Nobody on the list. That's Tonya Greer's study hall on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and she deserves the credit for it, not me. She's keeping it going through the playoffs.

Boosters: The Boston butt sale finished at 208 butts sold and $6,240 raised. The goal was $4,500. The money goes toward new sideline headsets. Carla Mims sent over the final numbers, and Hargrove's Meat Market did the smoking at cost, so they've earned a thank you.

Buses: I know transportation needs requests 5 days out for away games. If we win Friday and end up on the road, I'll get the bus stuff to you right away.

Holler if you need anything else before noon.
